name: @medicine-wheel/memory
description: Asking the wheel's memory, whoever keeps it: one contract that names no provider (scope, reach, answer, source, provider), the rule that turns a scope into ceremonies, a text match over the wheel's own records, and the orchestration a wheel server or any caller shares. Zero dependencies.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
